searchText: thanks for the recommendation <@!405158743920345128>, i made it! 🙂 > A validator should create and broadcast the `attestation` to the associated attestation subnet when either (a) the validator has received a valid block from the expected block proposer for the assigned `slot` or (b) one-third of the `slot` has transpired (`SECONDS_PER_SLOT / 3` seconds after the start of `slot`) -- whichever comes _first_. does anyone implement option (A) as of yet? based on medalla, it seems like all attestations start dropping in at the 4s mark
